name: Zhuhai CosMX Battery Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhuhai CosMX Battery Co., Ltd. specializes in the global production and distribution of polymer lithium-ion batteries, serving markets both within China and internationally. Their diverse product portfolio includes batteries for mobile phones, laptops, miniature electronics, and various other devices. Beyond consumer gadgets, these power solutions are also vital components in sectors such as passenger vehicles, electric motorcycles, broader electric vehicles, telecommunications infrastructure, and electricity grids. The company, which maintains its headquarters in Zhuhai, China, was established in 2007 and formally adopted its current name, Zhuhai CosMX Battery Co., Ltd., in March 2019, having previously operated as Zhuhai Coslight Battery Co., Ltd.
